skip.source_cn: 埃德加担心斯莱泽会询问有关黑金商会或班题斯的种种事务，指导你该如何推卸问题。除此之外，他还特意叮嘱你，莫蒂默庄园内已经不再有血仆侍奉。

en.text: Concerned that Salazer may ask about the Syndicate or Bantus, Eryndor teaches you how to deflect questions. He also reminds you that Mortimer Manor no longer keeps blood thralls.
